findings.highlight: I finished healing it about an hour after Berserker left.
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーが立ち去った後、一時間ほどで治療を済ませました
findings.governingReading: After Berserker departed, Saber completed treatment in roughly one hour.
findings.explanation: The English can mean that completion occurred at the one-hour point without preserving the healing duration beginning after departure.

findings.explanation: mirror moon prints two competing completions, adds “easily” in one, and leaves a dangling comma.
